Once upon a time:
, there was a big mountain. On top of the mountain, there was a small house. In the house, a boy named Tom lived with his mom and dad. They were a happy family.
One day, Tom wanted to go up the mountain. He asked his mom and dad if they could go. They said yes and gave him a map. Tom took the map and started walking up the mountain. The map showed him where to go.
On the mountain, Tom met a girl named Sue. Sue was ignorant and did not know the way back down the mountain. Tom said, "I will help you go up." They walked together and soon, they reached the top. Tom and Sue were very happy. They became good friends and went back to their homes on the mountain.

, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy loved to play with her soft toy cat. She would squeeze it tight and make it go "squeak, squeak" as it played with her. Lucy had so much fun with her toy cat and her toy dog.
One day, Lucy's friend Tim came over to play. They played with the soft toy cat and the toy dog. But then, Tim wanted to squeeze the toy dog because it looked like so much fun. Lucy didn't want her friend to be sad, so she let him squeeze the toy dog.
Tim squeezed the toy dog really tight and it started to squeak. Lucy was upset and tried to squeeze the toy dog tighter, but Tim squeezed it too hard. Suddenly, the toy dog broke into pieces and fell on Lucy's soft toy cat. Lucy cried, and Tim felt bad. They couldn't play with the toy cat and the toy dog anymore.

, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a special toy, a toy fairy named Fifi. Lily loved Fifi very much. They played together every day.
One day, Lily went to the park with Fifi. She saw a big tree with lots of pretty leaves. Lily wanted to pick some leaves to take home. Fifi said, "Lily, don't do that! That's a foolish idea." But Lily did not listen to Fifi.
Lily picked many leaves and started to go home. But she did not see the big rock in the way. She tripped on the rock and fell down. Fifi flew out of her hands and broke into pieces. Lily cried and cried.
The moral of the story is to listen to your friends and not to be foolish.
